status: Complete interface review; scoped word analysis implementation in progress.
insights: Value facts are location-specific: edge, instruction and individual use are separate queries. A global fact cache cannot safely reuse a fact established on only one branch.

Lazy analysis caches have explicit invalidation hooks for edge threading, forgotten values, erased blocks and complete resets. An Ink cross-call fact cache would need exact source and lexical scope identities; the current new implementation uses per-invocation scopes and no persistent cache.
Range queries explicitly distinguish undef permission. Ink total word semantics must not import this permission or LLVM poison facts.
The propagation pass returns preserved-analysis information; changing source and keeping all prior facts would require justification.
Header exposes only the pass interface; it does not prove the implementation behavior or establish complete LLVM control-flow coverage.
transfer: Derive constraints separately inside true/false choose arms; intersect simultaneous constraints and union arms; reconstruct full guarded expression and independently prove an unconditional equality. Database templates can generalise masks with explicit checked conditions.
remaining: Audit LazyValueInfo.cpp/CorrelatedValuePropagation.cpp, widen scoped fact rules only after concrete proof-backed examples, investigate context-aware memoization if measured worthwhile; no global contract facts or runtime adaptation added.
